structured_output.summary: Added IfRange.check; rewrote Range.make_content_range (clamping, first range, no is_byte_range_valid; range_for_length delegates); ETagSet.from_header already discards invalid unquoted values so only a regression test was added. Tests added in tests/test_datastructures.py. Not run (no command access).

criteria_notes.note: test_if_range_check covers strong equal, different, weak on either side, missing response values, date equal/different, and empty IfRange.

test_range_make_content_range (clamped stop/suffix, first range only, None cases, is_byte_range_valid patched to fail), test_range_make_content_range_no_ranges, test_range_for_length_deprecated. Range.from_header and ContentRange.from_header already validate; existing tests in test_http.py cover them.
test_etag_set_from_header_discards_invalid; the existing parser already dropped invalid unquoted values, so etag.py is unchanged and this test passes at base too.
